title: TDDN: Text-aligned Diffused DINO Network for Puzzle Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2609.07937v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Structured visual reasoning, such as image puzzles, demands fine-grained visual perception, an ability current Vision Language Models (VLMs) lack. VLMs built on CLIP-based ViT backbones trade fine-grained detail for high-level semantics, and we show this loss propagates downstream. To recover it, we fuse DINOv3 and CleanDIFT representations into a perception encoder (DiffusedDINO) and align it with RoBERTa-L, yielding a text-aligned model TDDN that preserves this perceptual advantage: with frozen backbones and only $\sim$590K alignment pairs, TDDN matches CLIP on image-text retrieval, surpassing it on three of four settings. It does so while more than tripling CLIP's dense-prediction accuracy (ADE20K 5.20 $\to$ 18.11 mIoU, COCO-Stuff 7.35 $\to$ 24.44), despite CLIP's massive training corpus. translated_title: TDDN：面向谜题理解的文本对齐扩散DINO网络
translated_abstract: 结构化视觉推理（如图像谜题）需要细粒度的视觉感知能力，而当前的视觉语言模型（VLM）缺乏这种能力。基于CLIP的ViT骨干网络构建的VLM以牺牲细粒度细节为代价换取高层语义，我们证明这种损失会向下游传播。为了恢复这种能力，我们将DINOv3和CleanDIFT表示融合到一个感知编码器（DiffusedDINO）中，并将其与RoBERTa-L对齐，从而得到一个文本对齐的模型TDDN，该模型保留了这种感知优势：在冻结骨干网络且仅使用约59万个对齐数据对的情况下，TDDN在图文检索任务上与CLIP相当，并在四个设置中的三个上超越了CLIP。同时，TDDN将CLIP的密集预测准确率提高了三倍以上（ADE20K从5.20提升到18.11 mIoU，COCO-Stuff从7.35提升到24.44），尽管CLIP拥有庞大的训练语料库。在包括SigLIP 2在内的通用对比编码器中，TDDN在分割基准测试中处于领先地位。我们进一步引入了谜题感知（Puzzle Perception），一种……
tldr: 提出TDDN模型，通过融合DINOv3与CleanDIFT表示并与RoBERTa-L进行文本对齐，在仅使用约59万个对齐数据对且冻结骨干网络的情况下，恢复了CLIP所缺乏的细粒度视觉感知能力，在图文检索和密集预测分割任务上大幅超越CLIP，从而提升了图像谜题理解能力。
en_tdlr: TDDN fuses DINOv3 and CleanDIFT representations and aligns them with RoBERTa-L, restoring the fine-grained visual perception that CLIP lacks—surpassing CLIP on image-text retrieval and more than tripling its dense-prediction accuracy using only ~590K alignment pairs with frozen backbones, enabling better puzzle understanding.
